title: Fugue in C major, BWV 953

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 10–13).
sections.leads: From C major to G major

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 7–8) in part, with soprano and bass exchanged, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Returns in Episode 6 (bars 31–33).
sections.leads: From G major to A minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (5 times). Alto: a figure from the subject (5 times). Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From A minor to E minor

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of the subject, inverted and the opening of the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject (4 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a fourth every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From E minor to G major

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted.
sections.leads: Between two statements in G major

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 10–13), with the soprano's line in the alto, the bass's line in the soprano, at the same pitch level. Soprano: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G major to C major

sections.label: Coda
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in C major at bar 36
